name: Living Concourse
notes: Station interiors are now a 2.5D concourse: standing crew, Y-sorted furniture, and speech on the same wheel layout.
Hangar has a shuttle, crates, and a pad tech; clerks staff the desks; walkers, a hauler, sitters, and the concierge fill the hub.
Desks are kiosks with hanging signs instead of flat icon pads. Planet sites stay overhead.
Rollback point: git checkout v2.12.1 restores the bird’s-eye station. Stick mapping and hull collision are unchanged.
